user_query:
For Apple, conduct a structured assessment of its market and financial position 
    over the supplied analysis period. Examine the direction and consistency of its share-price movement 
    and identify notable changes in market trend. Assess valuation using the available price-to-earnings 
    ratio and market capitalization, explaining what each metric can and cannot establish. Calculate 
    historical total returns and assess volatility and maximum drawdown where sufficient observations 
    are available. Compare the implications of the market, financial and quantitative findings without 
    treating repeated copies of the same underlying evidence as independent corroboration. Identify 
    any disagreement between sources, missing metrics, incomplete observations or tool limitations. 
    Distinguish measured facts from external contextual research, avoid unsupported causal claims, 
    and state whether the evidence is sufficient for a defensible conclusion. Keep the final assessment 
    specific to the requested period, explain material limitations, and do not provide an unsupported 
    buy or sell recommendation.
